title: Strengthen department employee directory backend tests
decisions: Add direct usecase and HTTP handler coverage using in-memory fakes; do not add DATABASE_URL-dependent tests or modify frontend code.
Assert the existing authorization, department existence, scoped query, search, pagination, sort allow-list/fallback, phone response, and sensitive-field redaction contracts.
No production-code adjustment is planned because the handler and service already expose injectable interfaces and the requested behaviors are directly testable.
breaking_change: None; test-only changes plus documentation records.
